summary: Play Sudoku with local SDM imports, 36 original puzzles, notes and saved games.
release_notes: Import local Open Sudoku SDM puzzles copied by USB. Validated imported games keep their clues, notes and undo history after reopening.
page_description: Play 36 original Sudoku puzzles or import local Open Sudoku SDM files copied by USB. Imported puzzles are checked for a unique solution. Pencil notes, undo, checking and saved games survive reopening without the source file.
